name: browser-sqlite
description: Browser SQLite with concurrent read / serial write isolation, backed by Web Workers and wa-sqlite
author: LAlex

scripts.test:chrome:not-isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 900 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser chrome --modes not-isolated --full
scripts.test:chrome:isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 600 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser chrome --modes isolated --full
scripts.test:firefox:not-isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 900 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser firefox --modes not-isolated --full
scripts.test:firefox:isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 600 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser firefox --modes isolated --full
scripts.test:safari:not-isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 900 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser safari --modes not-isolated --full
scripts.test:safari:isolated: node scripts/bounded.ts 600 node scripts/test-plan.ts --browser safari --modes isolated --full
scripts.test:conformance: node scripts/bounded.ts 1800 node scripts/test-parallel.ts --project "conformance chrome" --project "conformance firefox"
scripts.bench:serve: npx --yes kill-port 8099 && pnpm bench:build && node scripts/static-server.ts _site 8099

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: if [ -f "$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)" ] && ! git diff --cached --quiet HEAD -- package.json pnpm-lock.yaml patches/; then SKIP_INSTALL_SIMPLE_GIT_HOOKS=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi && node scripts/hook-gate.ts pre-commit --run
simple-git-hooks.pre-merge-commit: if ! git diff --cached --quiet HEAD -- package.json pnpm-lock.yaml patches/; then SKIP_INSTALL_SIMPLE_GIT_HOOKS=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi && node scripts/hook-gate.ts pre-merge-commit --run
simple-git-hooks.post-checkout: if [ "$3" = 1 ] && ! git diff --quiet "$1" "$2" -- package.json pnpm-lock.yaml patches/ 2>/dev/null; then pnpm install; fi
